description: Unlock the full potential of your Power BI reports with the 2WriteBack Visual, a powerful tool that enables seamless data entry and writeback directly within Power BI. This innovative visual allows you to write back data to any database using a REST API interface, providing a streamlined solution for data management and reporting. Key Features: - Direct Data Entry: Empower users to enter and update data directly within Power BI, eliminating the need to switch between applications. - Flexible Integration: Write back data to any database, ensuring compatibility with your existing infrastructure. - REST API Interface: Utilize a robust REST API for secure and efficient data transfer. Licensing Information: To enable the writeback functionality, a license is required. Our flexible licensing model includes: Per User License: Priced at CHF 20 per month, this license is ideal for small teams and individual users. Tenant-Wide License: For organizations with 25 or more users, we offer a comprehensive tenant-wide license. This option removes any restrictions on the number of users or reports, ensuring maximum flexibility and scalability for your business. Please contact our sales team. Experience the convenience of direct data entry within Power BI and optimize your workflow with the 2WriteBack Visual. Get your license today and start transforming the way you manage data.
